title: Stay Safe: Wallet Security
objectives: Identify phishing websites and malicious copycat URLs
Understand what you are actually signing when approving a transaction
Learn what token approvals and delegate permissions mean

steps.title: The Golden Rules of Web3 Security
steps.body:
In crypto, you are your own bank. That freedom comes with responsibility:

1. **Bookmark official URLs:** Attackers buy sponsored Google ads with deceptive lookalike URLs (e.g. `phantorn.app` or `jup-airdrop.xyz`). Always check your browser address bar.
2. **Inspect transaction simulation:** Wallets like Phantom show a preview of what tokens leave your wallet. If a site says 'Claim 5,000 Free USDC' but the wallet popup says '-2.5 SOL', reject it immediately!

steps.title: Under the Hood: How Token Drainers Work
steps.body: Malicious drainers work by asking you to sign an instruction that sets a third-party address as the 'delegate' authority over your token accounts, or sends all your SOL as a transaction fee. Because transactions execute atomically on Solana, one rogue approval can empty all delegated accounts in a single block.

questions.prompt: You see a sponsored Google search result for a popular decentralized exchange offering a 'bonus $500 reward'. What is the safest action?
options: Click the ad immediately to claim the bonus
Do not click sponsored ads; type the verified URL directly or use a saved bookmark
Connect a wallet containing your main savings
Approve all requested transactions without reading
questions.explainRight: Correct! Phishing ads frequently buy top search spots with counterfeit replica websites.
questions.explainWrong: Never click sponsored ads for crypto dapps. Phishing replicas frequently appear at the top of search engines.

questions.prompt: Your wallet popup says you are sending 5 SOL to an unknown address, but the website claims you are receiving an airdrop. What should you do?
options: Reject and cancel the transaction immediately
questions.explainRight: Always trust what your wallet extension's simulation shows over whatever text appears on a webpage!
questions.explainWrong: Reject it! The wallet extension shows the true on-chain instruction. The website is trying to trick you.
